internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Smart supermarket is a well established supermarket which started operations in retail in 1981. The Supermarket is located in the heart of Birkirkara. It is laid out on one floor, having parking areas and multiple access points, making shopping easier. Within the Supermarket one can find; fresh bread daily from our own bakery, a Deli counter, a fish monger, a fresh vegetable counter, a butcher and Naturali organic foods shop.
